cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: The Same Ending
cards.instruction: Use every new emotional detail as evidence that the same feared ending is becoming inevitable.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. You ended your message with 'take care.' That's how my last breakup started.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You said you had a cold. I meant get better.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. He wanted me healthy before he left too. Less guilt.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: So we're at the final kindness. Will it be in a container you don't need back?

mechanism: A interprets its pupil improved courtesy as training for the same abandonment A fears from an earlier relationship.
confusable: Not simply accusing B of poor manners: even genuine care is recast as more skilled farewell preparation.
comparison: Care during illness versus a rescheduled date.
seedUse: D120 take care/cold/soup/container; S05 taught consideration becomes feared independence.
